text:
sam: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands about customer wins/losses. We'll use this thread for clarifying questions for leadership and short follow-ups. TL;DR: Wins: Dedicated latency SLAs, predictable cost reporting, reliability. Losses: compliance timelines (FedRAMP/HIPAA), missing SAML/SSO for Private, per-route throttling. Please keep replies short, tag owners, and paste any direct customer quotes.

marta: Can we get a breakdown of wins by vertical (SaaS, fintech, healthcare)? ballpark numbers are fine.

josh: Sales note: 2 closed deals cited Dedicated SLA; 1 loss due to compliance timeline. Top asks: FedRAMP roadmap, SSO/SAML, longer log retention.

li: Eng: FedRAMP ~6mo with dedicated squad. SAML/SCIM MVP ~8 weeks if prioritized. Need budget signoff.

devon: Support: customers ask for per-route throttles and better quota alerts. If Console shows per-route cost/latency, tickets drop.

kelly: Growth: Acme approved a case study verbally. Need legal/comms signoff. Also request a "why we won" one-pager for sales.

marta: Product/PLs: list top 3 customer asks and mark paid vs free. That will help prioritization.

sam: Leadership: SSO high priority for Private (Q2 target for MVP). FedRAMP funded but realistic ETA Q4. Log retention/per-route metrics medium priority; accelerate if tied to cost savings.

josh: Can we provide a stopgap for FedRAMP customers? dedicated contracts + network isolation?

li: We can offer network isolation and stricter SLA but must avoid misrepresenting compliance. Ops to document controls.

ops-bot: Created doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/all-hands/wins-losses-followup (editable by @marta,@li,@josh).

devon: Paste two customer quotes from tickets: 
> "We switched to Redwood Dedicated because we finally hit consistent p95 under 120ms."
> "We couldn't onboard until SAML was supported 2 we chose another vendor."

kelly: I'll draft the sales one-pager and drop it here for review.

marta: I'll populate the doc with vertical breakdowns and an ask matrix. First pass by tomorrow AM.

sam: Thanks everyone. Leadership will review Marta's doc and follow up with prioritization and budgets. Post any further short items here. :thumbsup:
